description: Defines CUDAStream and CUDAEvent classes as wrappers around c10::cuda::CUDAStream and at::cuda::CUDAEvent, including their methods and Torch binding code.

classes.name: CUDAStream
classes.description: Wrapper around c10::cuda::CUDAStream with additional methods and Torch binding.

classes.name: CUDAEvent
classes.description: Wrapper around at::cuda::CUDAEvent with additional methods and Torch binding.

methods.name: CUDAStream::query
methods.description: Checks if the CUDA stream has completed.

methods.name: CUDAStream::recordEvent
methods.description: Records a CUDAEvent on the stream.

methods.name: CUDAStream::waitEvent
methods.description: Waits for a CUDAEvent on the stream.

methods.name: CUDAStream::device_index
methods.description: Returns the device index associated with the stream.

methods.name: CUDAStream::device
methods.description: Returns the Device object associated with the stream.

methods.name: CUDAEvent::elapsedTime
methods.description: Calculates elapsed time between this event and another.

methods.name: CUDAEvent::ipcHandle
methods.description: Returns an IPC handle for the CUDA event.

methods.name: CUDAEvent::query
methods.description: Checks if the event has completed.

methods.name: CUDAEvent::record
methods.description: Records the event on a CUDAStream.

methods.name: CUDAEvent::wait
methods.description: Waits for the event on a CUDAStream.
